findings.defect: The stranger is identified as Jeok Cheongang at the start of Chapter 512, so this resolved reveal is incorrectly preserved as an open hook.
findings.rationale: Leaving the identity unresolved contradicts both Chapter 512 and the checkpoint plot summary and could cause later continuity work to conceal or re-resolve an already revealed fact.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang approached Taekyung by walking across the water, brought him food, and persuaded him to abandon the shark-assisted shortcut.

findings.rationale: Active continuity is used downstream; retaining the pre-reveal description risks false ambiguity and contradictory future summaries.
